story: Write Japanese in exactly 8–12 short sentences ending in 。 or ！ or ？. Favor everyday vocabulary, simple particles and consistent polite です/ます forms. Do not imply equivalence to JLPT N5. Preserve appropriate kanji; use hiragana and katakana for the rest. Never use romaji. Annotate EVERY kanji in BOTH text and title by replacing the empty segments/titleSegments arrays with ordered {"text":"surface","reading":"kana"} segments. Concatenating segment text must EXACTLY reconstruct the canonical text/title, including punctuation and whitespace. Place readings ONLY above kanji runs. Keep compounds made entirely of kanji together, not split mechanically by character. Written kana (including okurigana and prefixes) must be separate segments with reading:null. For example 行きます becomes [{"text":"行","reading":"い"},{"text":"きます","reading":null}], 食べます becomes 食/た + べます/null, and 学校 stays 学校/がっこう. Never annotate 行きます with いきます or duplicate its written kana in the reading. Each segment containing kanji must have its full kana reading. Kana-only and punctuation segments use reading:null. Keep individual kanji-containing segments under 20 characters. In glossary entries whose headword includes kanji, supply the full headword reading in kana. English meanings stay English.
suggestions: Suggest 5–10 useful Japanese beginner vocabulary items for the optional topic, using appropriate kanji and kana. No romaji. Suggestions will be editable before the story is generated.
